Name: Hyena (Shi)
Description: Jivan Shi was angered at losing his status as a doctor because his medical degree from India was not recognized in the United States. Jivan Shi now as a therapist manipulated Summer Day into becoming the Hyena again and to infect him with the "curse" so that he could gain revenge on the medical community.
